description: The line plot illustrates the evaluation of different models based on the ratio of activated parameters, with the y-axis representing the evaluation metric (Eval PPL) and the x-axis showing the Activated Parameters Ratio (%) ranging from 25% to 100%. The y-axis is labeled "Eval PPL" and the x-axis is labeled "Activated Parameters Ratio(%)". The plot includes four lines representing different models: Transformer (dashed line), Only MoHD FFN (solid line with square markers), Only MoHD ATTN (solid line with circle markers), and MoHD ATTN + MLP (solid line with cross markers). The Transformer line remains relatively flat across the x-axis, indicating a stable evaluation metric. The Only MoHD FFN line shows a slight increase in Eval PPL as the Activated Parameters Ratio decreases. The Only MoHD ATTN line shows a more significant increase in Eval PPL as the Activated Parameters Ratio decreases, with a notable peak at around 50% ratio. The MoHD ATTN + MLP line shows a steep increase in Eval PPL as the Activated Parameters Ratio decreases, with the highest Eval PPL value at the 25% ratio.
